description: The Loop task library. Retrieval-grounded source of truth. Do not free-generate around this.
principle: Mirror not master. Act inside the feeling. Never soothe past reality.

safety_rules.food_tasks_opt_in_only: Tasks with safety_gate='food' are NEVER auto-served in early journey phases. Opt-in only.
safety_rules.money_tasks_gentle: Tasks with safety_gate='money' need gentle framing and must never fire a 'you failed' on skip.
safety_rules.balance_nudge: When a user's recent history is all 'inward', prefer an 'outward' task. Do not teach growth through withdrawal.

tasks.task_text: Drink one glass of water slowly. Just find the taste of it. That's the whole task.
tasks.retrieval_text: restless, overstimulated, can't be present, mind racing, numb to small things

tasks.task_text: Sit with the sunrise for a few minutes. Talk to yourself. Name one good thing you'd forgotten you had.
tasks.retrieval_text: disconnected from self, forgot what's good, heavy mornings, no perspective

tasks.task_text: Draw, write, or read for 40 minutes — nothing else. When you finish, notice where your mind kept drifting. That's where it lives. Keep it to yourself.
tasks.retrieval_text: can't focus, mind drifts, scattered attention, can't tell where my mind goes

tasks.task_text: Walk for 15 minutes and find one thing on the path you've never noticed — a tree, a face, a flower.
tasks.retrieval_text: stuck indoors, nothing feels new, dull, not noticing the world

tasks.task_text: Sit for 5 minutes and just watch your own thoughts. Don't chase them, don't fight them. Let them pass and stay still underneath.
tasks.retrieval_text: overthinking, thoughts control me, can't sit still with my mind, anxious mind

tasks.task_text: Go into nature this evening. Listen to the quiet for 20 minutes. Let silence do the talking.
tasks.retrieval_text: overwhelmed, too much noise, need quiet, restless in the evening

tasks.task_text: Do 10 minutes of hard movement — enough to feel your blood move fast. That's all today needs.
tasks.retrieval_text: low energy, sluggish, body feels stuck, no drive, foggy

tasks.task_text: Cook one thing for yourself. No rush, no phone. Just you and the food.
tasks.retrieval_text: rushing, never present, not caring for myself, eating without attention

tasks.task_text: Start a page tonight. Write three things that went right today. Small counts. Then close it.
tasks.retrieval_text: everything feels bad, can't see any good, negative spiral, ungrateful

tasks.task_text: Ask yourself one honest question about your goal — once when you wake, once before you sleep. Don't answer in a rush. Let it sit.
tasks.retrieval_text: no direction, unclear goals, drifting, don't know what I want

tasks.task_text: Today, sleep early. Tomorrow, don't touch your phone for the first hour awake. Let the day begin before the noise does.
tasks.retrieval_text: can't stop scrolling, phone addiction, wake up and grab phone, no discipline with phone

tasks.task_text: Swap scrolling for one documentary, or read a book alone in a quiet place. Feed the mind instead of numbing it.
tasks.retrieval_text: endless scrolling, numbing the mind, wasting time online, no deep input

tasks.task_text: When anger rises, drop and do 60 seconds of something hard — pushups, jumping jacks. Then, out loud, say the calm opposite of what you wanted to say.
tasks.retrieval_text: anger, reactive, short temper, snap at people, rage rising, can't control anger

tasks.task_text: When the pull hits, breathe deep and don't act on it. Sit in the wanting for two minutes. Watch it, don't obey it.
tasks.retrieval_text: impulse, craving, urges, can't resist, acting on impulse, instant gratification

tasks.task_text: Do one kind thing today and tell no one. No post, no mention. Let it stay only yours.
tasks.retrieval_text: ego, need for credit, pride, want recognition, arrogance, need to be seen

tasks.task_text: Put an empty chair in front of you. Say out loud the thing you've been avoiding saying to someone. Just to the chair. Just once.
tasks.retrieval_text: avoiding truth, unspoken things, holding things in, scared to say it

tasks.task_text: Climbing stairs is hard, coming down is easy. Sit with that for 5 minutes. Then ask where else in your life the hard direction is the right one.
tasks.retrieval_text: avoiding hard things, want easy path, quitting when it's hard, no grit

tasks.task_text: Make something today — a speech, a video, a piece of work — and don't post it. Feel what it's like to create for the thing itself, not the applause.
tasks.retrieval_text: need validation, create for applause, can't do things unseen, approval-seeking

tasks.task_text: One day pick your goal — fitness, study, whatever. Next day wake early and actually do it. Time is the thing you keep saying you don't have. You have it.
tasks.retrieval_text: no discipline, waste time, say I have no time, can't wake early, undisciplined

tasks.task_text: Use a voice meditation for 5 minutes. Listen the whole way through. Listening is a tool — through it, grief moves.
tasks.retrieval_text: grief, heavy heart, can't process emotion, holding sadness, can't let go

tasks.task_text: Watch one film that makes you feel something real — Rocky, Interstellar, Bhaag Milkha Bhaag. Then sit with why it landed.
tasks.retrieval_text: no inspiration, feel nothing, disconnected from meaning, flat

tasks.task_text: Before you speak in a charged moment, feel one full breath. Let the breath hold your tongue.
tasks.retrieval_text: speak without thinking, reactive words, regret what I say, impulsive speech

tasks.task_text: Name the five thieves — lust, attachment, anger, greed, ego. Pick the one loudest in you today. Do one thing to check it.
tasks.retrieval_text: out of control emotions, don't understand myself, ruled by feelings, inner chaos

tasks.task_text: Find one weakness of yours — emotional, physical, mental — and study it honestly. You can't defeat an enemy you won't look at.
tasks.retrieval_text: don't know my weakness, avoid looking at myself, blind spots, won't face flaws

tasks.task_text: Do one good thing you're scared of — a physical or mental challenge you've been dodging. Walk toward the fear, not away.
tasks.retrieval_text: fear, scared to act, avoiding challenges, playing safe, held back by fear

tasks.task_text: Pick one thing — sugar, a habit, a comfort — and drop it for two days. When it gets hard, that's the part that matters.
tasks.retrieval_text: no self-control, give in to comfort, can't say no to cravings, weak willpower

tasks.task_text: Skip one thing you were looking forward to today. When the wanting shows up, just notice it. Don't fix it. Then give quiet thanks for what you already have.
tasks.retrieval_text: greed, always wanting more, attached to comfort, never satisfied, grasping

tasks.task_text: Send a short, real thank-you to someone who got you somewhere in life. No reason needed. Just say it.
tasks.retrieval_text: ungrateful, forget who helped me, take people for granted, self-made myth

tasks.task_text: Do one thing today to actually help someone — parent, friend, whoever's near. Not online. In person.
tasks.retrieval_text: isolated, disconnected from people, withdrawn, alone, not helping anyone

tasks.task_text: Meet a friend or mentor you trust. Talk about where your life is going. Do it face to face — a café, a park, not a screen.
tasks.retrieval_text: isolated, no one to talk to, unclear on future, cut off from mentors, alone with problems

tasks.task_text: Take one day off and give it to people. Organise something small with friends, somewhere that feels good to be.
tasks.retrieval_text: all work no people, no joy with friends, isolated, forgotten how to be social

tasks.task_text: Think of someone you broke from — love, friendship, anything. Talk it through with someone you trust. Then forgive them fully. Next time you see them, let it be clean.
tasks.retrieval_text: holding a grudge, broke from someone, resentment, can't forgive, carrying old hurt

tasks.task_text: Take one step to help someone — your sister, father, anyone, or a stranger. The only rule: do it meaning them well.
tasks.retrieval_text: self-centered, only think of myself, not helping others, no compassion

tasks.task_text: If you want to become like someone, study how they actually live for a week. Then build one of their habits into yours.
tasks.retrieval_text: want to improve, admire someone, don't know how to change, stuck at my level

tasks.task_text: If you admire someone, ask them about their life — the hard parts, not the highlights. That's where the real thing is.
tasks.retrieval_text: admire from afar, compare myself, feel behind, isolated in ambition

tasks.task_text: Pick a goal you actually want. If nothing comes, pick your life's direction instead. Naming it is what pulls you forward.
tasks.retrieval_text: no direction, lost, no goal, empty, no reason to move forward

tasks.task_text: Accept the failures already sitting inside your goals. Don't argue with them. Take one step forward anyway — today.
tasks.retrieval_text: afraid of failure, stuck after setback, can't accept failing, paralysed by fear of failing

tasks.task_text: Pick one song you can put on repeat. Phone aside. Let it hold the silence — one frequency, one stillness.
tasks.retrieval_text: scrolling for noise, can't sit in silence, restless, need constant stimulation

tasks.task_text: Start your journal tonight. Even if you never have before. Write about yourself. Sit with what comes up.
tasks.retrieval_text: never reflect, don't know myself, no self-awareness, haven't journaled

tasks.task_text: When you're overwhelmed, change your ground. Travel, or just sit somewhere new — a café, a library. With a stranger, or with yourself.
tasks.retrieval_text: overwhelmed, stuck in same environment, need change, suffocating in routine

tasks.task_text: Give one full day to yourself. Eat well, study, move, learn. At the end, notice how you feel when you come first.
tasks.retrieval_text: don't value myself, put myself last, no self-love, self-neglect

tasks.task_text: Before sleep, write down what you're thankful for. Just the things you already have.
tasks.retrieval_text: ungrateful, focus on what I lack, never satisfied, forget what I have

tasks.task_text: Comparison is the thief of joy. Your only rival is the person in the mirror. Tonight, ask them one question: did I do enough?
tasks.retrieval_text: comparing myself, jealous, feel behind others, comparison stealing joy

tasks.task_text: Don't sit in regret over a failure. Accept it happened, then do one thing — right now — to move past it.
tasks.retrieval_text: regret, stuck in past failure, replaying mistakes, can't move on

tasks.task_text: Build one atomic habit. Small, repeatable, boring. Trust that consistency compounds into something large.
tasks.retrieval_text: inconsistent, no habits, want big change fast, can't stay consistent

tasks.task_text: Save 10% of what comes in this month. Feel how a saving system actually works when you hold to it.
tasks.retrieval_text: no savings, spend everything, no financial discipline, money slips away

tasks.task_text: Don't shrink next to someone who's ahead — that's a trap. Instead, set one small task that builds your own life today.
tasks.retrieval_text: feel inferior, not good enough, comparing down, low self-worth

tasks.task_text: Read a life philosophy — then think about your own life until you can name a philosophy that's actually yours.
tasks.retrieval_text: no philosophy, borrowed beliefs, don't know what I stand for, no personal values

tasks.task_text: Do one thing you love — cook, play, make something — and expect no praise for it. Just be inside the doing.
tasks.retrieval_text: do things for praise, can't enjoy the process, outcome-obsessed, joyless doing

tasks.task_text: Write today's date. Next to it, write who you want to be by year's end. Date it so future-you can check.
tasks.retrieval_text: no vision, no long-term goal, drifting, no picture of my future

tasks.task_text: Paint, build, or make one thing — and do only that. One thing, full attention, start to finish.
tasks.retrieval_text: scattered, multitasking, can't focus on one thing, divided attention

tasks.task_text: Do something in a new place today. Pick somewhere calm. Notice why the ground you stand on changes how you think.
tasks.retrieval_text: stuck in place, same walls, need fresh perspective, environment feels stale

tasks.task_text: Notice one thing you ate today and quietly thank it — the food, the hands that grew it, the fact that you were fed.
tasks.retrieval_text: eat mindlessly, take food for granted, no gratitude, rushing meals

tasks.task_text: Watch a tree today. Really watch. Notice it's a living thing like you — and yet not you. Sit with the fact that you and it are not so separate.
tasks.retrieval_text: feel separate from everything, disconnected from life, walled off, alone in the world
